title: canna lutea var. maculata
intro: Canna lutea var. maculata, commonly known as Yellow Gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Gentian include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea, and act as a mild diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
